dialogText:
Business must be good, huh?
The Paramilitary thanks you.

Careful... money attracts trouble.
You could leave this bag with me.

Got some cash, huh?
Let's see what fits your budget.

Not bad... could be worse.
Buy wisely.

You sure you can
afford anything here?

We can talk way more when
your pockets are heavier.

Are you kiddin' me?
No money.
